## In plain English

Nightly Linux coverage went red on one timing test in the shell authz classifier. The test builds a command with sixteen thousand arithmetic shifts, then checks that classification still finishes under one second and still marks a protected last-positional write as unknown. On the failing run that check took about 1072 ms under coverage. The twin zip test with the same shift pile and the same one-second budget passed at about 960 ms. Locally without coverage the same last-positional test finishes in well under a second. So the product intent is still linear-time preprocessing; the meter that failed is an absolute wall-clock that coverage noise can push over the line.

Prefer-A keeps both twin fixtures and the unknown classification check. It replaces the shared absolute one-second assert with one shared helper that fails closed when elapsed growth looks quadratic across two input sizes, and keeps only a hang-guard absolute ceiling. Raising only the last-positional budget, deleting a twin, or skipping the check under coverage is Reject.

## Bound remedy

- Keep the #4005 zip twin and the #4188 last-positional twin: sixteen thousand arithmetic shifts, then assert the protected dest still classifies as unknown.
- Replace both `expect(elapsedMs).toBeLessThan(1_000)` asserts with one shared helper that times the same classify path at N and 2N (or N and N/2), fails closed when the elapsed ratio looks quadratic, and keeps a hang-only absolute ceiling so a stuck run still dies.
- Reject: delete either twin; raise only the #4188 budget; skip or soften the check under coverage; mark the tests slow without a complexity assert.

## Why this shape

Evidence: run 45347677233 attempt 1 on SHA 492fc16b; Linux coverage job failed `packages/core/src/authz/classify.test.ts` `preprocesses arithmetic shifts without quadratic rescans for last-positional dest (#4188)` at 1072ms; sibling `#4005` passed at 960ms; tip pin for this arc is 7b592c7f1d28eec29e7b249ece7020568dbb64d5; local vitest of the same last-positional case passed in ~125ms without coverage.

- P1: Absolute 1s wall-clock on the #4188 last-positional twin flakes under Linux coverage (1072ms observed) while the #4005 zip twin with the same shift count stays under budget on the same run.
- P2: Raising only the #4188 budget or skipping under coverage would leave the #4005 twin on the same fragile meter and weaken the quadratic-guard signal the fixtures exist to carry.
- P3: Deleting either twin or converting both to unbounded slow tests would drop the fail-closed linear-time proof for arithmetic-shift preprocess that #4005/#4188 locked.

Round-1 critique of Prefer-A draft 7153254212 (charter: refutation; ceiling 7153254440).

## Verdict

Prefer-A correctly refutes Stop 1's target that the twin absolute `toBeLessThan(1_000)` meters are a durable quadratic-guard under Linux coverage. Keep both twins and replace the absolute complexity claim with a scale-ratio check. Bind is blocked until Bound names a concrete fail-closed ratio predicate and a hang ceiling that is not the same fragile 1s meter.

## Inventory (before new mechanisms)

Pin-read at `7b592c7f1d28eec29e7b249ece7020568dbb64d5`:

- `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts` `zipShellArithmeticShiftIndexes` (~1808–1846): one forward scan over the line; quote/paren depth; records `<<` only inside `$((...))` / bounded `((...))`. Product preprocess is already linear.
- `zipStripHereDocDeclarationsFromLine` calls that index set once per line (~1853) before the heredoc strip walk — both twins exercise this path through `classifyShellAuthzOps`.
- `packages/core/src/authz/classify.test.ts` #4005 twin (~1599–1607): `" << 1".repeat(16_000)` then `zip …`; asserts `unknown` + `elapsedMs < 1_000`.
- Same file #4188 twin (~1719–1727): same shift pile then `mkfile 1k …`; same absolute assert.
- Nightly comment 7125967519 (run 45347677233 attempt 1, SHA 492fc16b): only the #4188 twin failed; Prefer-A records 1072ms vs #4005 at 960ms on that run.

Repo inventory for a reusable scale-ratio / quadratic-growth helper under `packages/core`: none found for this meter class. Nearby absolute wall-clock expects exist (cache scanner / styles / install-health cheap). CONTRIBUTING § Slow tests (#975) still treats ~1s as the contributor decision point — Prefer-A's Reject of "mark slow without a complexity assert" matches that bar. A file-local shared helper in `classify.test.ts` (or a tiny authz test util) is enough; no new product module.

## Findings

### F1 — Ratio predicate and hang ceiling unbound
class: blocks-the-design

evidence: Prefer-A Bound limb 2 says the helper "fails closed when the elapsed ratio looks quadratic" and "keeps a hang-only absolute ceiling," and offers `N and 2N (or N and N/2)` without choosing. No numeric ratio threshold, no warm/cold protocol, no hang-ceiling value appear on the lean.

failure mode: Implementers invent "looks quadratic" (e.g. ratio ≥ 3 vs ≥ 1.8) and either re-use `1_000` as the hang ceiling (same coverage flake class as 7125967519 / 1072ms) or set a ceiling so high the hang guard never fires. The refutation of the absolute meter succeeds in prose while the Bound still leaves the fail-closed association unstated.

disposition consequence: Prefer-A cannot bind as written. Remint Bound limb 2 to name (a) which scale pair is normative, (b) the fail-closed ratio (or equivalent) predicate, (c) a hang ceiling distinct from the old 1s complexity claim, and (d) that both twins call the same helper.

### F2 — Coverage noise vs ratio signal; N sizing
class: sharpens-framing

evidence: Prefer-A plain English: product intent remains linear; absolute meter failed under coverage (~1072ms) while the sibling twin passed (~960ms). Pin-read twins already spend most of their work in full `classifyShellAuthzOps`, not an isolated call to `zipShellArithmeticShiftIndexes`. Timing N and 2N doubles that cost under instrumentation.

failure mode: Fixed overhead + coverage jitter can flatten or scramble 2N/N so a still-linear path looks unstable, or a quietly quadratic path hides under overhead if N is too small. A Bound that only says "ratio looks quadratic" without requiring preprocess-dominated N (16k is the existing anchor) invites a false-green helper.

disposition consequence: Lean can bind after Bound states that N stays on the existing 16k-class input (or proves preprocess dominates), that both samples use the same classify entry as today's twins, and that coverage noise is why ratio+hang replaces absolute-1s — not a license to shrink N until the ratio is cheap.

### F3 — Twin retention is inventory-correct
class: footnote

evidence: #4005 grammar is verified `zip [quiet] <archive> <input>` first-positional dest (`hasProtectedZipArchiveDestination`); #4188 is unknown-argv0 last-positional dest-of-write. Both pin-read tests share the arithmetic-shift preprocess but disagree on command shape. Prefer-A Keep + Reject (delete either twin) matches that inventory.

failure mode: none for Prefer-A as written; deleting a twin would drop one grammar's regression surface while claiming the shared preprocess is still guarded.

disposition consequence: none — retain Prefer-A Keep/Reject on twins.

### F4 — Helper siting
class: footnote

evidence: inventory found no existing shared quadratic-guard helper; CONTRIBUTING #975 wants fast default lanes and forbids hiding flakes behind slow markers.

failure mode: exporting a new production API for a test-only meter would grow surface without need.

disposition consequence: implement as test-local shared helper unless a second consumer already exists (none pin-read).

## Injection / swarm lens

Target is a classifier test meter and Bound size for two existing fixtures. No authority, envelope, identity, worktree, or shared-state change. Lens does not fire beyond noting the classify path under test remains the existing PreToolUse/authz surface.

## Road not taken

- Raise both absolute budgets (e.g. 2s) and keep a single sample: clears 1072ms with less mechanism; still an absolute wall-clock quadratic claim and leaves Prefer-A Reject's fragile-meter pain (P1/P2) open. Flip only if operator accepts absolute meters as hang guards only and drops the "quadratic" name from the fixtures.
- Unit-time only `zipShellArithmeticShiftIndexes` at N/2N: tighter on the linear scan; misses proving both zip and last-positional classify routes still hit that preprocess. Flip if Bound splits preprocess complexity from grammar unknown asserts (Prefer-A correctly keeps unknown on both twins).

## Steelmans

Strongest reject of Prefer-A: the nightly miss is a 72ms coverage overshoot on one twin; a shared 2s absolute ceiling on both twins is Thin Fail-Closed enough. What flips that: Stop 1 refutation-target and P2 — absolute wall-clock is what the fixtures advertised as the quadratic-guard, and Prefer-A's Reject list is the right refusal of that story under coverage.

## In plain English

The nightly coverage lane failed one arithmetic-shift timing test under instrumentation while its twin stayed just under the same one-second budget. The classifier preprocess is already linear; the meter was the problem. This Bound keeps both twin fixtures and their unknown classification checks, and replaces the shared absolute one-second claim with one shared test helper that times the same classify path at 16k and 32k shifts, fails closed when 2N/N is at least 3.5, and uses a ten-second hang ceiling that is not a complexity claim. Confirming this map makes those limbs the next build.

## Bound remedy

- relieves: P1 — Keep the #4005 zip twin and the #4188 last-positional twin at the existing 16k-class shift pile and assert each protected dest still classifies as unknown through `classifyShellAuthzOps`.
- relieves: P2 — Replace both absolute `toBeLessThan(1_000)` asserts with one file-local shared helper that both twins call; the helper times the same classify entry at N=16_000 and 2N=32_000, fails closed when elapsed(2N)/elapsed(N) >= 3.5, and keeps hang-only absolute ceilings of 10_000 ms on each timed sample (not a complexity claim and not a reuse of 1_000).
- relieves: P3 — Reject delete-either-twin, raise-only-#4188-budget, skip-or-soften-under-coverage, mark-slow-without-complexity-assert, shrink-N-to-cheapen-ratio, and any new production API for this test-only meter.

## Takes

- 7153340784 F1 Ratio predicate and hang ceiling unbound — accept-into-contract — Bound remedy item 2
- 7153340784 F2 Coverage noise vs ratio signal; N sizing — accept-into-contract — Bound remedy item 2
- 7153340784 F3 Twin retention is inventory-correct — accept-into-contract — Bound remedy item 1
- 7153340784 F4 Helper siting — accept-into-contract — Bound remedy item 2 (file-local) and item 3 (no production API)

Disagreement set: empty.

## Footnotes

Optional single warm classify call before the timed N/2N pair is an implementation note, not a Bound limb. Windows nightly failures on other files stay on #7172/#7199.

## Reachability (false-relief check)

- P1 live path after ship: both #4005 zip and #4188 last-positional twins keep the 16k-class shift pile and `unknown` asserts through `classifyShellAuthzOps`; the absolute `toBeLessThan(1_000)` complexity claim is removed. Coverage overshoot like 1072ms on #4188 no longer fails a one-second complexity meter.
- P2 live path: one file-local shared helper both twins call; N=16_000 and 2N=32_000 on the same classify entry; fail closed when elapsed(2N)/elapsed(N) >= 3.5; hang-only ceilings 10_000 ms per sample. Reject list bars raise-only-#4188, skip-or-soften-under-coverage, and shrink-N.
- P3 live path: Keep both twins (Bound item 1) plus Reject delete-either-twin / mark-slow-without-complexity-assert / unbounded conversion (Bound item 3). Linear-time proof stays on the shared ratio predicate, not a slow-marker hide.

Pin inventory matches Round-1: `zipShellArithmeticShiftIndexes` is one forward scan; both twins still use `" << 1".repeat(16_000)` plus absolute `< 1_000` today at classify.test.ts ~1599-1608 and ~1719-1728.

## Pain map

- P1 relieved — Bound item 2 replaces the fragile absolute 1s claim on both twins (including the #4188 flake surface).
- P2 relieved — shared helper + Reject raise-only / skip-soften / shrink-N keep the quadratic-guard signal on both fixtures.
- P3 relieved — Keep twins + Reject delete / mark-slow-without-complexity-assert preserve fail-closed linear-time proof.

## Round-1 disposition check

- F1 (blocks-the-design) relieved — Bound names normative N/2N pair, ratio predicate >= 3.5, hang ceiling 10_000 ms distinct from 1_000, and shared helper both twins call.
- F2 (sharpens-framing) relieved — 16k-class N retained; same classify entry; coverage noise is why ratio+hang replaces absolute-1s.
- F3 / F4 footnotes absorbed — twin retention and file-local helper / no production API are Bound items 1-3.

## Writing-bar (#3368 / #5783)

Naming of the file-local helper and any optional single warm classify call before the timed N/2N pair stay footnotes / implementation notes (Bound Footnotes already). No harvest change.
